turns.text: Then when she shared her journalism background, David asked more about it.
turns.zh: 然后当她分享了自己的新闻从业背景后，David 又问了很多相关的事。

turns.text: This back and forth questioning shows genuine interest and keeps conversations alive at intermediate level.
turns.zh: 这种来回提问显示出真正的兴趣，也让中级水平的对话能一直聊下去。

turns.text: This is what separates good speakers from great ones.
turns.zh: 这就是好说话者和高手之间的区别。

turns.text: The work life balance topic was interesting too.
turns.zh: 工作与生活平衡那个话题也挺有意思的。

turns.text: They touched on professional topics but in a casual way.
turns.zh: 他们聊到了职业话题，但方式很随意。

turns.text: They talked about departments working together, upcoming campaigns, but mixed it with personal stuff like hobbies and cooking classes.
turns.zh: 他们聊了部门协作、即将推出的活动，但还掺进了爱好、烹饪课这类私人话题。

turns.text: This balance between professional and personal is essential in workplace conversations.
turns.zh: 这种职业与个人之间的平衡，在职场对话里至关重要。
